title: 挫屈束制支撐安裝
subcategoryTitleEn: Building seismic, precast and fire safety
summary: 從挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑與層間變位換算核心應變出發，檢查核心、套管與脫層材及節點板的設計，再把重點放在安裝：重力荷載與安裝時機造成的預壓、現場配合誤差與螺栓鎖固，接著談 AISC 341 資格試驗與震後評估、防火與熱膨脹，最後是更換與交接，並以 One Rincon Hill、鹽湖城國際機場與日本製鐵工程的無黏結支撐公開資料對照。
summaryEn: Starting from the load path of buckling-restrained braced frames and the conversion of storey drift into core strain, check the core, casing, unbonding layer and gusset design, then focus on installation: preload from gravity loads and installation timing, fit-up misfit and bolt tightening, followed by AISC 341 qualification tests and post-earthquake assessment, fire and thermal expansion, and finally replacement and handover, compared with public information on One Rincon Hill, Salt Lake City International Airport and Nippon Steel Engineering's unbonded brace.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、吊裝或張拉作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, lifting or stressing permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

labelsEn: Seismic force from slab and beam

architectureNodes: Seismic force from slab and beam

stages.title: 工程背景、荷載與結構系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」與「層間變位與核心應變需求」：先建立傳力機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" and "Storey drift and core strain demand": build the load path and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「支撐核心降伏力」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brace core yield force” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。這讓支撐像一個以鋼材塑性耗能的阻尼器：地震力經樓板傳到梁，再由節點板進入支撐，核心降伏限制了傳入構架的最大力，梁、柱與節點板則依支撐可能的最大力做容量設計，保持彈性。日本製鐵工程公開說明，其無黏結支撐自上市 30 餘年來已交付超過 10 萬支。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「支撐核心降伏力」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The brace thus acts as a damper dissipating energy through steel plasticity: earthquake force passes from the slab into the beam, through the gusset into the brace, and core yielding caps the force entering the frame, while beams, columns and gussets are capacity-designed for the maximum brace force and remain elastic. Nippon Steel Engineering states that more than 100,000 of its unbonded braces have been delivered in over 30 years on the market. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Brace core yield force” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「支撐核心降伏力」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Brace core yield force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑
knowledge.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame

knowledge.textEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The brace thus acts as a damper dissipating energy through steel plasticity: earthquake force passes from the slab into the beam, through the gusset into the brace, and core yielding caps the force entering the frame, while beams, columns and gussets are capacity-designed for the maximum brace force and remain elastic.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「挫屈束制支撐安裝」的「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：機制與傳力路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出載重來源、構件、接點與支承的傳力邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「城市結構維護班」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與幾何版本、支承條件、荷載方向與獨立位移紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: mechanism and load path” in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”. Draw the load, member, connection and support load paths; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Urban structures maintenance shift” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for geometry revision, supports, load direction and independent displacement records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" is correct?
options: 支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。
挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。
支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
optionsEn: Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel.
A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar.
Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
quiz.explanation: 挫屈束制支撐（BRB）由一根可降伏的鋼核心與包覆它的鋼套管及砂漿組成，套管防止核心在受壓時整體挫屈，使核心在拉與壓兩個方向都能降伏並形成飽滿的遲滯迴圈。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A buckling-restrained brace (BRB) consists of a yielding steel core enclosed by a steel casing and mortar; the casing prevents overall buckling of the core in compression, so the core yields in both tension and compression with full hysteresis loops. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支撐核心降伏力」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brace core yield force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。以應變硬化係數 ω = 1.4 與受壓強度調整係數 β = 1.1，最大拉力 T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN，最大壓力 C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN，梁柱與節點板依此做容量設計。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN. With strain-hardening factor ω = 1.4 and compression adjustment factor β = 1.1, the maximum tension is T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN and the maximum compression C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN, which govern capacity design of beams, columns and gussets. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。以應變硬化係數 ω = 1.4 與受壓強度調整係數 β = 1.1，最大拉力 T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN，最大壓力 C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN，梁柱與節點板依此做容量設計。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN. With strain-hardening factor ω = 1.4 and compression adjustment factor β = 1.1, the maximum tension is T_max = ω·P_ysc ≈ 1,932 kN and the maximum compression C_max = β·ω·P_ysc ≈ 2,125 kN, which govern capacity design of beams, columns and gussets. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame", which statement holds?
options: 只要支撐本身合格，節點板照一般斜撐設計就可以。
支撐兩端孔位差幾公釐沒關係，用吊具拉一下就能裝上。
核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。
optionsEn: If the brace itself is qualified, the gusset can be designed as for an ordinary brace.
A few millimetres of misfit do not matter, since a hoist can pull the brace into place.
With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN.
quiz.explanation: 核心面積 A_sc = 4,000 mm²、標稱 F_y = 345 MPa：P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With core area A_sc = 4,000 mm² and nominal F_y = 345 MPa, P_ysc = 4,000×345 ≈ 1,380 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支撐核心降伏力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brace core yield force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：規格書應規定核心鋼材的降伏強度範圍（上下限），並要求每批鋼板試片報告；容量設計所用的 ω 與 β 必須取自該產品的資格試驗，不可直接沿用其他廠牌數值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The specification should set an upper and lower bound on core yield strength and require coupon reports for every plate heat; the ω and β used in capacity design must come from that product's qualification tests, not from another manufacturer's values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。
knowledge.textEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 規格書應規定核心鋼材的降伏強度範圍（上下限），並要求每批鋼板試片報告；容量設計所用的 ω 與 β 必須取自該產品的資格試驗，不可直接沿用其他廠牌數值。
knowledge.textEn: The specification should set an upper and lower bound on core yield strength and require coupon reports for every plate heat; the ω and β used in capacity design must come from that product's qualification tests, not from another manufacturer's values.

quiz.question: 要驗證「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame"?
options: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比。
量測時不必記錄溫度、日照、風與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
挫屈束制支撐外觀沒有變形，就表示裡面的核心沒有損傷。
optionsEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects.
Temperature, sunshine, wind and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If a BRB looks undeformed, its core is undamaged.
quiz.explanation: 設計時列出每支支撐的 P_ysc、T_max、C_max 與所連接的梁、柱、節點板需求比；核心鋼材以鋼板試片的實測降伏強度確認落在規格範圍內，避免實際強度過高使構架超載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In design, tabulate P_ysc, T_max and C_max for every brace with the demand ratios of the beams, columns and gussets it connects; confirm from coupon tests on the core plate that the measured yield strength falls within the specified range, so that an overly strong core does not overload the frame. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「支撐核心降伏力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brace core yield force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：日本製鐵工程公開說明，其無黏結支撐自上市 30 餘年來已交付超過 10 萬支。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nippon Steel Engineering states that more than 100,000 of its unbonded braces have been delivered in over 30 years on the market.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐的鋼材強度越高越安全，所以核心用高強度鋼最好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stronger brace steel is always safer, so the core should use the highest-strength steel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。
knowledge.textEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「挫屈束制支撐構架的受力路徑」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load path of a buckling-restrained braced frame" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。
支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first.
Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
quiz.explanation: 若核心鋼材實際降伏強度遠高於設計值，支撐在設計地震中不降伏，力量直接傳入柱與基礎，可能使柱或節點板先破壞；反之核心太弱，則在中小地震就降伏並累積損傷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If the actual core yield strength is far above design, the brace does not yield in the design earthquake and force flows straight into columns and foundations, which may fail first; a core that is too weak yields in minor earthquakes and accumulates damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：機制與傳力路徑
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: mechanism and load path
steps.objective: 說明「核心降伏段應變」如何影響挫屈束制支撐安裝的受力、變形或耐久表現，並畫出荷載的來源、傳遞路徑與支承邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core yielding-zone strain” governs force, deformation or durability in “Buckling-restrained brace installation”, and map where loads come from, how they travel and where they are supported.
steps.instruction: 支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。降伏段越短，同樣的層間變位就造成越大的核心應變，低週疲勞壽命也越短；降伏段越長，支撐越柔、層間變位越大。因此核心降伏段長度是在構架勁度與核心應變之間取捨，必須與製造商的試驗應變範圍對照。 師傅任務：以自由體圖或傳力路徑圖畫出荷載如何經過「核心降伏段應變」傳到支承或基礎，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. A shorter yielding zone gives larger core strain for the same drift and shorter low-cycle fatigue life; a longer one makes the brace more flexible and increases drift. The yielding-zone length is therefore a trade-off between frame stiffness and core strain and must be checked against the manufacturer's tested strain range. Mentor task: draw a free-body or load-path diagram showing how loads pass through “Core yielding-zone strain” to the supports or foundation, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在傳力圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your load-path diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 傳力圖標明「核心降伏段應變」的荷載來源、傳遞路徑與支承；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The load-path diagram shows load sources, path and supports for “Core yielding-zone strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求
knowledge.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand
knowledge.text: 支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。降伏段越短，同樣的層間變位就造成越大的核心應變，低週疲勞壽命也越短；降伏段越長，支撐越柔、層間變位越大。
knowledge.textEn: A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. A shorter yielding zone gives larger core strain for the same drift and shorter low-cycle fatigue life; a longer one makes the brace more flexible and increases drift.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「層間變位與核心應變需求」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storey drift and core strain demand" is correct?
options: 支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。
套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。
支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。
optionsEn: Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability.
The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will.

A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform.
quiz.explanation: 支撐的變形需求來自層間變位：樓層水平位移在斜撐方向的分量就是支撐伸縮量，而這個伸縮量主要集中在核心的降伏段，兩端的加勁連接段幾乎不變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A brace's deformation demand comes from storey drift: the component of horizontal storey displacement along the brace axis is the brace elongation or shortening, concentrated in the yielding zone of the core while the stiffened end zones barely deform. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「核心降伏段應變」的關鍵量，並判斷跨度、荷載、溫度或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Core yielding-zone strain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when span, load, temperature or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。層間變位 2%×4,000 = 80 mm，支撐伸縮 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm；降伏段取工作點長度的 60%，L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm，核心應變 ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%，試驗須涵蓋其兩倍約 3.1%。數值為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m. A 2% drift of 80 mm gives a brace deformation of 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm; with a yielding zone of 60% of the work-point length, L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm and core strain ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%, so tests must cover twice that, about 3.1%. Values are teaching assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。層間變位 2%×4,000 = 80 mm，支撐伸縮 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm；降伏段取工作點長度的 60%，L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm，核心應變 ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%，試驗須涵蓋其兩倍約 3.1%。數值為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m. A 2% drift of 80 mm gives a brace deformation of 80×cos33.7° ≈ 66.6 mm; with a yielding zone of 60% of the work-point length, L_ysc ≈ 4,327 mm and core strain ≈ 66.6/4,327 ≈ 1.54%, so tests must cover twice that, about 3.1%. Values are teaching assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「層間變位與核心應變需求」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Storey drift and core strain demand", which statement holds?
options: 柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。
支撐越早鎖固越好，可以順便當施工期間的穩定斜撐。
只要支撐廠牌有任何一份試驗報告，所有尺寸的支撐都算合格。
optionsEn: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m.
The earlier braces are connected the better, since they can double as construction bracing.
Any test report from a brace manufacturer qualifies braces of every size.
quiz.explanation: 柱距 6 m、樓高 4 m：支撐角 θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7°，工作點長度約 7.21 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: With a 6 m bay and 4 m storey, the brace angle is θ = atan(4/6) ≈ 33.7° and the work-point length about 7.21 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「核心降伏段應變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Core yielding-zone strain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：支撐訂購表要列出每支支撐的工作點長度、降伏段長度、設計變形與最大變形，由製造商確認落在其資格試驗範圍內；設計變更影響樓高或柱距時，須重新計算核心應變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: The brace schedule should list work-point length, yielding-zone length, design and maximum deformation for every brace, confirmed by the manufacturer to lie within its qualification range; any change to storey height or bay width requires recalculating core strain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大；若核心應變分析只用平均樓層位移而忽略扭轉，角落支撐的需求會被低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、日照與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps; using average storey displacement while ignoring torsion underestimates demand on corner braces. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, sunshine and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。
knowledge.textEn: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 支撐訂購表要列出每支支撐的工作點長度、降伏段長度、設計變形與最大變形，由製造商確認落在其資格試驗範圍內；設計變更影響樓高或柱距時，須重新計算核心應變。
knowledge.textEn: The brace schedule should list work-point length, yielding-zone length, design and maximum deformation for every brace, confirmed by the manufacturer to lie within its qualification range; any change to storey height or bay width requires recalculating core strain.

quiz.question: 要驗證「層間變位與核心應變需求」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Storey drift and core strain demand"?
options: 沿用另一座橋或另一棟建築的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較。
支撐裡面已經灌滿砂漿，所以不需要再做防火被覆。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another bridge or building counts as verifying this structure.

Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests.
A brace is already filled with mortar, so it needs no fireproofing.
quiz.explanation: 從非線性分析取得每支支撐在設計與最大考量地震下的最大變形，換算核心應變並與資格試驗達到的應變比較；日本製鐵工程公開說明其無黏結支撐在約 3% 至 4% 軸應變下仍有穩定遲滯與疲勞性能，可作為比較的量級參考。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take each brace's maximum deformation under the design and maximum considered earthquakes from nonlinear analysis, convert it to core strain and compare with the strain reached in qualification tests; Nippon Steel Engineering reports stable hysteresis and fatigue performance for its unbonded brace at about 3% to 4% axial strain, a useful order of magnitude for comparison. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 層間變位與核心應變需求：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Storey drift and core strain demand: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心降伏段應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core yielding-zone strain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大；若核心應變分析只用平均樓層位移而忽略扭轉，角落支撐的需求會被低估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps; using average storey displacement while ignoring torsion underestimates demand on corner braces. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此核心降伏段長度是在構架勁度與核心應變之間取捨，必須與製造商的試驗應變範圍對照。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The yielding-zone length is therefore a trade-off between frame stiffness and core strain and must be checked against the manufacturer's tested strain range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「支撐越短越硬越好，核心降伏段長度不影響耐久性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Shorter, stiffer braces are always better, and the yielding-zone length has no effect on durability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若為了提高勁度而把降伏段縮得很短，核心應變超過試驗範圍，強震時核心在數個大循環後斷裂，支撐失去強度，層間變位突然增大；若核心應變分析只用平均樓層位移而忽略扭轉，角落支撐的需求會被低估。
knowledge.textEn: Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps; using average storey displacement while ignoring torsion underestimates demand on corner braces.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「層間變位與核心應變需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Storey drift and core strain demand" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
套管只是外殼，壁厚可以任意減薄。

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The casing is just a shell, so its wall can be thinned at will.

quiz.explanationEn: Shortening the yielding zone to raise stiffness can push core strain beyond the tested range, so the core fractures after a few large cycles in a strong earthquake, the brace loses strength and drift jumps; using average storey displacement while ignoring torsion underestimates demand on corner braces.
